# Compliance packet

> Templates, not legal advice. District counsel must review each one before the district
> adopts or relies on it.

These are templates for a Wisconsin school preparing a Library Assistant Install for its
board, DPI, and counsel. They use the terms in [`CONTEXT.md`](../../../CONTEXT.md) and follow
ADR-0001 to ADR-0006.

| File | What it is | Who uses it |
|---|---|---|
| [`ferpa-analysis.md`](ferpa-analysis.md) | Legal reasoning: FERPA, Wis. Stat. 118.125, 43.30, COPPA | Counsel, the board |
| [`pia-template.md`](pia-template.md) | Privacy impact assessment in DPI's mini-template format | Librarian and district IT fill it in; the board approves it |
| [`retention-policy.md`](retention-policy.md) | Pupil-records rule for the daily Purge, Flags, Rosters, and records requests | The board adopts it as a rule |
| [`aup-insert.md`](aup-insert.md) | AUP insert with task tiers, the disclosure box, and rules for Students | The board, Teachers, Students |

Read `ferpa-analysis.md` first. It corrects two claims in ADR-0001: Wis. Stat. 43.30 may reach
school libraries, and the parent response window is FERPA's 45 days, not 60.

**Filled-in copies stay out of this repository.** Real staff names, systems, and network
details belong in a district-controlled store (see the root `README.md`). Items marked
`[VERIFY]` could not be confirmed against a primary source when these templates were written
(October 2026).
